name: Nikugoku no Hemi ~Inchuu to Shokushu no Suana ni Tojikomerareshi Joshuu-tachi no Matsuro ni Tsuite~
original_name: 肉獄のヘミ～淫蟲と触手の巣穴に閉じ込められし女囚達の末路について～
source:
Hemy wakes up to find herself in a room made of flesh. Other than her name, she doesn't remember anything and why she is caught up there...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ064627.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
赫米醒来后，发现自己身处一个由血肉构成的房间。除了自己的名字，她什么都不记得，也不知道为何会被困在这里……
